assignmentHtml.task: Research Movieclips YouTube channel comprehensively. Find: (1) Stable channel ID and canonical URL. (2) Operator: FlixFix / Warner Bros. Discovery? Corporate chain. (3) Channel creation date and earliest still-public upload. (4) Operating location and displayed country. (5) Languages. (6) Primary content category. (7) Content supply model: licensed movie clips/trailers. (8) Representative works. Provide direct source URLs.
assignmentHtml.context: Movieclips is #24/#26 with ~70-71B lifetime views per Communitrics snapshot dated September 2, 2026. Need verifiable facts with source links.
assignmentHtml.expected_output: A structured dossier for Movieclips with all requested fields, each with source URLs.

answerHtml:
Movieclips YouTube Channel Dossier

  1. STABLE CHANNEL ID & CANONICAL URL
  • Channel ID: UC3gNmTGu-TTbFPpfSs5kNkg
  • Canonical URLs (all resolve to same channel): https://www.youtube.com/channel/UC3gNmTGu-TTbFPpfSs5kNkg ; https://www.youtube.com/c/MOVIECLIPS ; https://www.youtube.com/@MOVIECLIPS
  1. OPERATOR & CORPORATE CHAIN
  • Operator: Fandango Media, LLC (NOT 'FlixFix' — no entity named FlixFix appears connected to Movieclips; the orchestrator's hypothesis is not supported).
  • Corporate chain: Movieclips was founded in 2009 as a division of ZEFR → acquired by Fandango in 2014 (renamed 'Fandango Movieclips') → Fandango acquired Rotten Tomatoes in 2016 → rebranded to 'Rotten Tomatoes Movieclips' in 2022.
  • Fandango Media is a joint venture between Versant (75%) and Warner Bros. Discovery (25%). WBD is a minority strategic partner, not the primary operator. Historic note: when Fandango acquired RT/Flixster in 2016, Warner Bros. took a 30% stake which was reduced to 25% by 2019.
  1. CREATION DATE & EARLIEST STILL-PUBLIC UPLOAD
  • Social Blade reports 'Created On: Apr 28, 2006' for the underlying YouTube account.
  • The Movieclips service launched December 3, 2009 (per Wikipedia infobox).
  • Earliest still-public uploads visible on the main channel: May 27, 2011 (The Matrix Revolutions clip series, e.g., 'It Ends Tonight'). Note: at least one early upload ('It Ends Tonight') is geo-restricted in some territories, so true 'still-public' status varies by region.
  • A separate promotional video 'Introducing MOVIECLIPS.com' was uploaded Dec 1, 2009 but to the distinct 'MOVIECLIPS News' channel (now merged/redirected), not the main channel.
  1. OPERATING LOCATION & DISPLAYED COUNTRY
  • Headquarters: Venice, Los Angeles, California, U.S.
  • Displayed country: United States
  1. LANGUAGES
  • Primary language: English. TMDB metadata confirms 495 of 496 videos are in English (en-US); one in Uzbek.
  1. PRIMARY CONTENT CATEGORY
  • Entertainment / Film & Animation. Specifically: licensed movie clips, trailers, featurettes, and promotional content from Hollywood studios.
  1. CONTENT SUPPLY MODEL
  • Licensed movie clips and trailers from major studio libraries: Universal Pictures, Amazon MGM Studios, Paramount Pictures, Warner Bros. Entertainment, Walt Disney Studios, 20th Century Studios, Sony Pictures, Lionsgate Films, DreamWorks Pictures.
  • Channel description states it is 'the largest collection of licensed movie clips on the web.'
  1. REPRESENTATIVE WORKS (by view count)
  • My Girl (1991) - First Kiss Scene (6/10): ~30.9M views (uploaded May 30, 2017)
  • Spy Kids 4: All the Time in the World (2011) - Hammer Hands and Jet Packs (11/11): ~29M views (uploaded ~2015)
  • Shrek (2001) - Do You Know the Muffin Man? Scene (2/10): ~27.1M views (uploaded Nov 19, 2018)
  • Shrek (2001) - An All-Star Ogre Opening Scene (1/10): ~18M views
  • The Little Rascals (1994) - You Are So Beautiful To Me Scene (1/10): ~13.1M views (uploaded Jul 8, 2019)
  • Additional popular franchises per TMDB: Iron Man 2, Scarface, Ice Age, Madagascar, Annie Hall, The Lorax, Shrek 2, The SpongeBob SquarePants Movie, Bee Movie

CHANNEL SCALE (as of Sept 2026): ~66.6M subscribers, ~70.8B lifetime views, ~45,600 videos (per Social Blade)

evidence.snippet: Channel identified as 'Movieclips' with channel ID UC3gNmTGu-TTbFPpfSs5kNkg. 496 videos listed, 454 clips, 41 trailers, 1 featurette. Languages: 'English (en-US) 495, Uzbek (uz-UZ) 1'. Popular movies include Iron Man 2, Elizabeth: The Golden Age, Scarface, Ice Age, Madagascar, Annie Hall, The Lorax, Shrek 2, The SpongeBob SquarePants Movie, Bee Movie.
evidence.supports: Channel ID, language, content category, representative franchise titles

evidence.snippet: 'Rotten Tomatoes Movieclips (formerly Movieclips and later Fandango Movieclips) is a company located in Venice, Los Angeles that offers streaming video of film clips, trailers, promotional content, and extra features from such Hollywood film companies as Universal Pictures, Amazon MGM Studios, Paramount Pictures, Warner Bros. Entertainment, Walt Disney Studios, 20th Century Studios, and Sony Pictures...' Founded 2009; HQ: Venice, Los Angeles, California, U.S.; Owner: Fandango; Launched December 3, 2009.
evidence.supports: Location, founding date, content model, studio partners, owner

evidence.snippet: 'Fandango Media, LLC... is a joint venture between Versant and Warner Bros. Discovery.' Owners: Versant (75%), Warner Bros. Discovery (25%). 'Its stake was reduced to 25% by 2019.'
evidence.supports: Corporate chain: Fandango Media JV structure with Versant majority and WBD minority stake

evidence.snippet: Channel statistics: Subscribers 67M, Views 71B, Videos 46K, Created On: Apr 28, 2006. Grade: A. Daily stats through September 2026 showing ~66.6M subs and ~70.8B total views.

evidence.supports: Earliest still-public uploads on main channel (May 27, 2011)

evidence.supports: Scarface is a popular franchise on the channel (also listed in TMDB popular movies), though individual clip view counts vary widely

evidence.snippet: 'Fandango acquired Movieclips from previous owner ZEFR in 2014. Two years later, the ticketing service scooped up Rotten Tomatoes... The Rotten Tomatoes YouTube Network is centered on the original Movieclips YouTube channel, which has amassed more than 57 million subscribers and upwards of 58 billion lifetime views.'
evidence.supports: Acquisition history (ZEFR → Fandango → Rotten Tomatoes rebrand), corporate relationship

evidence.snippet: 'In 2014, Movieclips was acquired by Fandango. Movieclips is located in Venice, Los Angeles, California, United States.' Subscriber milestones: 61 million by April 1, 2024; view milestones: 62 billion by May 19, 2024.
